execution_rules.rule_1_pre_execution_route_lock: Fully map all steps/stages in priority order before initiating execution. The written map becomes the strictly authorized route. No unmapped steps, route deviations, or mid-flight alterations permitted.
execution_rules.stage_commit_tracking: A verified git SHA must be recorded and logged upon successful completion of each individual stage.
execution_rules.blocker_halt_protocol: Apply blocker rule immediately upon hitting any execution, technical, or policy failure.

adjudication.gate_2_policy_compliance: schema_valid == TRUE AND zero_secrets_detected == TRUE AND negative_constraints_met == TRUE

acceptance_criteria.success_condition: Both Gate 1 (Technical) AND Gate 2 (Policy) verified PASS along mapped route with git SHAs.
acceptance_criteria.blocker_condition: Apply blocker rule on failure at either Gate 1 or Gate 2.
